title: Pip and the Big Breakfast Wagon
moral: When we work together, even big jobs become easy and fun.
description: Nana Hoot's little red wagon is full of breakfast for her neighbours, but a giant AH-CHOO blows away all the name tags! Can Pip, Tumble and Hazel work out who eats carrots, acorns, seeds and grass? Learn what animals eat in this funny animated story about teamwork, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Good morning, friends! Nana Hoot had a little red wagon, full of breakfast baskets for her neighbours in Clover Wood.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo! Every animal eats something different. The carrots are for... and the acorns are for... zzzzz...
Uh-oh! Nana Hoot fell asleep, right in the middle of her sentence! Her glasses slid down, down, DOWN her beak.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Snort! I'm awake! I'm awake! Just follow the name tags, my dears.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! Leave it to us, Nana!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I'll pull the wagon all by myself! Hnnnnng!
The wagon did not move. Not one bit! Pip pulled harder, and his paws went slip, slip... BOING! Right onto his bottom!
He tried again. Hnnnnng... BONK! His tail got all tangled in the handle. Silly Pip!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Can I push? Two friends are stronger than one!
Pip pulled, Tumble pushed, and wheee, the wagon rolled! But the dust tickled Tumble's trunk... AH... AH... AH-CHOOOO! Whoosh! Every name tag blew away!
Oopsie-trunk! Now who gets which basket? Then, POP! A teeny hedgehog popped out of the bushes. It was Hazel!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee! I can help! Look, long ears are peeking out of that burrow.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: It's Bunny! I know, I know! Bunnies eat... PANCAKES!
BOING! Hazel's prickles stood straight up! Hee hee, no, Pip! What do rabbits love to munch? Carrots or acorns?
Carrots! You're right! Crunchy, orange carrots! Rabbits love carrots and leafy greens. Munch, munch, munch!
Next stop, the big oak tree! A fluffy squirrel waved her bushy tail at them.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I know this one! Squirrels eat... SOCKS!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee! No, Tumble! Squirrels eat nuts and acorns. Let's count the acorns together!
One, two, three, four, five acorns! Then... BONK! One more acorn bounced right off Tumble's cap!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Oopsie-trunk! Thank you, Squirrel. I think.
Two baskets left! A bag of teeny seeds, and a big bundle of grass.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Seeds? If I plant them... will they grow into BIRDS?
Ha ha! No, Tumble! Seeds grow into plants. But lots of birds love to EAT seeds! Peck, peck, peck!
Pip held the feeder still, Tumble lifted Hazel up high with his trunk, and Hazel poured the seeds in. Teamwork!
Tweet-tweet! Zip, zip! A blue bird and a yellow bird zoomed down for breakfast.

narration.text: That night, the friends parked the empty wagon by Nana's door. Hazel waved goodnight. Tee-hee!

narration.text: Pip pulled, I pushed, and Hazel helped us find the way!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper teamwork! Let's do a teamwork dance! Stomp, hop, twirl!
Tumble twirled so fast, his trunk went HONK! Nana Hoot laughed and laughed... and fell fast asleep. Zzzzz...

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Goodnight, my super helpers!
